name: css-composite-font
description: Tests and checks for the CSS Composite Font tool. The site itself has no build step.

scripts.setup: npm ci && npx playwright install chromium && python3 -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/pip install -q -r tests/requirements.txt
scripts.test:py: sh -c 'if [ -x .venv/bin/python ]; then exec .venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/py; else exec python3 -m pytest tests/py; fi'
scripts.verify: npm run check && npm run test:py && npm test
